content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Spartanburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and documented project hours meet PMI's criteria before applying. Spartanburg's automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics employers frequently develop project leaders who qualify.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously with active certified practitioners, complete interactive coursework, and build the formal education foundation PMI requires—all from your Spartanburg location, on a schedule that fits your career.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay the required exam fee through PMI's portal. Plan for processing time before your eligibility window opens and you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and strategy guidance to reinforce the PMBOK framework. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center and complete the computer-based assessment. You control the test date within your eligibility window.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification lasts three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, conference attendance, volunteer service, or published work to renew. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education options to help you sustain your credential and stay current in project-management practice.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
